maddeler.e:
ازدجرت (form VIII)
# اِزْدَجَرْتُ (izdajartu) /iz.da.d͡ʒar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# اِزْدَجَرْتَ (izdajarta) /iz.da.d͡ʒar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# اِزْدَجَرْتِ (izdajarti) /iz.da.d͡ʒar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# اِزْدَجَرَتْ (izdajarat) /iz.da.d͡ʒa.rat/: thi
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
